adapter-entry-point.method: Accepted Workspace CLI Capability validation and byte-identical staged Provider Entry Point generation

publication-readiness.method: Repository behavioral tests prove complete Notes-owned provenance input, deterministic current-state preparation, exact concept separation, bounded readiness, explicit ambiguity exclusion, and unavailable or stale refusal with no writes

provenance-and-authorization.method: Repository contract and recorder tests prove deterministic existing-claim reuse, duplicate refusal, exact short-lived user authorization, candidate selection closure, and authority-expanding field refusal

atomic-recorder.method: Repository behavioral and production-adapter tests prove serializable transaction configuration, exact three-table routing, current-state revalidation, audit output, idempotent retry, concurrency-safe reuse, and complete rollback after injected partial failure

authority-boundary.method: Repository contract and adapter tests prove the sole purpose-built recorder and refusal of direct API, Supabase MCP, ad-hoc SQL, generic write, status, Decision Item, strategy, position, and trade authority

provider-semantic-equivalence.method: Compared the exact Codex adapter with issue #63, parent #46, predecessor #62, CONTEXT.md, the canonical publication workflow's useful intent, and the Notes/Trade Journal authority boundary; representative output was used without live provider invocation

eligible-environment.method: The configured repository runtime completed non-mutating CLI help and focused read/refusal validation on 2026-08-08; missing database, source, provider, authorization, sandbox, or network prerequisites remain explicit unavailable or refused outcomes
